modules.title: Module 1: Mindset Reset & Skill Positioning
modules.description: Shift from trading time for low pay to positioning a high-value skill in the Nigerian and global market.

modules.title: Module 2: Market Research & High-Demand Problems
modules.description: Identify profitable niches and urgent business problems clients gladly pay premium fees to solve.

modules.title: Module 3: Core Skill Mastery & Speed Execution
modules.description: Build repeatable workflows and professional execution standards that set you apart immediately.

modules.title: Module 4: Crafting an Irresistible Offer
modules.description: Package your skill into outcome-driven deliverables instead of selling cheap hourly labor.

modules.title: Module 5: Building Proof & Case-Study Portfolio
modules.description: Create compelling portfolio assets and real-world samples even if you are starting from zero.

modules.title: Module 6: Pricing for 1 Million Naira & Beyond
modules.description: Structure retainers, milestone pricing, and value-based quotes in Naira and foreign currencies.

modules.title: Module 7: Authority Presence & Personal Brand
modules.description: Optimize your digital storefront, bio, and social credibility so prospects trust you before speaking.

modules.title: Module 8: Outbound Client Acquisition Engine
modules.description: Daily outreach systems across email, LinkedIn, Instagram, and WhatsApp without sounding desperate.

modules.title: Module 9: Discovery Calls & Closing High-Ticket Deals
modules.description: Lead confident sales conversations, diagnose client needs, and handle price objections gracefully.

modules.title: Module 10: Contracts, Invoicing & Getting Paid Safely
modules.description: Protect your work with simple agreements, upfront deposits, and seamless local/international payouts.

modules.title: Module 11: Client Delivery & Retention Systems
modules.description: Deliver remarkable results on schedule so clients stay on monthly retainers and refer others.

modules.title: Module 12: Scaling from First Client to ₦1M Milestone
modules.description: Compound referrals, raise your rates systematically, and manage multiple active projects cleanly.

modules.title: Module 13: Inbound Content & Lead Magnets
modules.description: Attract inbound leads consistently using educational breakdowns and targeted lead magnets.

modules.title: Module 14: International Remote Clients & USD Positioning
modules.description: Position yourself for UK, US, and European clients while working effectively from anywhere.

modules.title: Module 15: Advanced Proposal Writing & Pitch Decks
modules.description: Write winning custom proposals for corporate contracts and high-budget retainers.

modules.title: Module 16: AI-Assisted Productivity & Workflow Acceleration
modules.description: Multiply your output speed without sacrificing originality or craft.

modules.title: Module 17: Strategic Partnerships & Referral Loops
modules.description: Partner with complementary agencies and creators for steady zero-ad-spend deal flow.

modules.title: Module 18: Handling Difficult Clients & Scope Creep
modules.description: Maintain boundaries, renegotiate scope expansions, and turn tense moments into wins.

modules.title: Module 19: Productizing Your Service
modules.description: Convert custom freelance work into standardized fixed-scope packages with higher margins.

modules.title: Module 20: Building Micro-Teams & Ethical Delegation
modules.description: Bring on vetted collaborators when demand exceeds your solo weekly capacity.

modules.title: Module 21: Financial Management & Reinvesting Skill Profit
modules.description: Separate business cashflow, taxes, emergency reserves, and growth capital.

modules.title: Module 22: Building Authority Case Studies & Video Testimonials
modules.description: Capture measurable client ROI stories that sell your next 10 deals automatically.

modules.title: Module 23: High-Ticket Upsells & Multi-Quarter Retainers
modules.description: Expand existing client account value ethically with strategic advisory retainers.

modules.title: Module 24: Agency Transition vs. Elite Solo Consultant
modules.description: Choose and architect the long-term operating model that fits your lifestyle goals.

modules.title: Module 25: Challenge Capstone & Long-Term Wealth Roadmap
modules.description: Final synthesis, live market execution review, and next-level positioning beyond ₦1M.
